acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Host Ira Glass and Aviva DeKornfeld visits refugee camps we don’t call refugee camps—right on our country’s doorstep.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Los Angeles Times reporter Molly O’Toole talks to U.S. asylum officers—the people who end up sending migrants back to Mexico. And they don’t feel good about it. This story is a collaboration with the Los Angeles Times. Read Molly's story here.
acts.title: Goodbye, Stranger

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Reporter Emily Green happens to meet a man being sent back to Mexico who tells her he’s afraid of being kidnapped—and then, he gets kidnapped. Read Emily's report on Vice.
acts.title: Take the Long Way Home
